title: Raft leader election
brief: Show a client-visible goal first, then an election end to end, then terms, votes, timeouts and one network partition. Use one running example. Complete the whole flow before opening its pieces. Include spoken narration; label illustrative states as illustrations.
audience: Software engineer comfortable with basic programming and algebra, new to this mechanism. Define formal terms on first use.

constraints.description: A concrete purpose/example and full end-to-end journey appear before internal machinery and equations. Each zoom refers to an established box and returns to the whole.
A smooth animation that makes a minority partition safely elect a leader or confuses election with commitment fails.
